commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+7' 3 - 2 The ball hits the back of the net! Alejandro Rego showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) manages to convert it into a sweet goal. He heads it inside the right post and gets on the scoresheet – 3:2.

90+3' 3 - 1 Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Unai Simon is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 3:1.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

90' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) climbs above the defence to meet the free kick, but plants his header well wide of the right post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.

89' Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jesus Manzano with no other option than to blow for a foul. Atl. Madrid have a free kick.
88' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
86' Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
84' Total attempts – 4:9.
82' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
81' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
78' The Ath Bilbao players are exchanging some short passes.
75' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
74' A pass lands at the feet of Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Ath Bilbao win a corner.
72' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Giuliano Simeone will be replaced by Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid).
72' We are about to witness a substitution. Obed Vargas (Atl. Madrid) is replacing Koke.

71' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
70' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
70' Inaki Williams will be replaced by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao).
70' Ernesto Valverde prepares a substitution. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta is replaced by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) is coming onto the pitch as Nico Williams cannot continue after picking up an injury.

69' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ath Bilbao.
66' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
64' Unai Gomez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao).
64' Ernesto Valverde has decided to substitute Yuri Berchiche and he is replaced by Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao).
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) for Antoine Griezmann.
63' It is time for a substitution. Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is on for Marcos Llorente.
62' That was close. Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.

59' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
58' Diego Simeone is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Pablo Barrios suffers an injury and Johnny Cardoso (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
56' The attendance for today's match is 56598.
54' 2 - 1 Goal! Alex Baena plays a simple square pass into the feet of Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
53' Great chance! Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
52' Neat passing move from Atl. Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
49' 1 - 1 Goal! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) gathered the ball off a rebound inside the box and fired home. He has every right to celebrate.
48' Atl. Madrid couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
47' The referee blows his whistle as Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) was too aggressive in his challenge. Atl. Madrid are awarded a free kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Ath Bilbao, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Rough tackle by Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Ath Bilbao have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.

45' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao will have a throw-in.
43' 59:41 – the ratio of ball possession.
41' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.

40' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Atl. Madrid are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
37' Unai Simon makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) after a cross from the side.
35' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jesus Manzano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
33' A quickly taken corner by Atl. Madrid.
33' Atl. Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The linesman points to the corner flag, Atl. Madrid are going to take it.
31' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
29' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
28' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
25' Atl. Madrid are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
23' 0 - 1 Gooal! Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta takes over corner duties. Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the left side of the net. 0:1.
23' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Ath Bilbao.
21' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
19' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
16' The Atl. Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
14' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
13' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
10' A corner kick by Atl. Madrid is thwarted by the well prepared Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao).
10' A cross from Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Now Atl. Madrid have a corner.
9' A lofted cross from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
7' The Ath Bilbao players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
5' The ball is cleared after Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
3' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the right side of the goal, but Jan Oblak pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
2' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Ath Bilbao will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jesus Manzano.
